mapper.select: SELECT current_message.* FROM integration_outbox current_message WHERE ((current_message.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND (current_message.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR current_message.next_attempt_at <= #{now})) OR (current_message.status = 'PUBLISHING' AND current_message.claim_until <= #{now})) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM integration_outbox earlier_message WHERE earlier_message.aggregate_type = current_message.aggregate_type AND earlier_message.aggregate_id = current_message.aggregate_id AND earlier_message.id < current_message.id AND earlier_message.status != 'PUBLISHED' ) ORDER BY current_message.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHING', claim_token = #{token}, claim_until = #{claimUntil}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND ((status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now})) OR (status = 'PUBLISHING' AND claim_until <= #{now}))

UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, update_time = #{publishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING' AND claim_token = #{token}

UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'RETRY', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING' AND claim_token = #{token}
